storylines.description: A side-neck turtle from a pet store is found to be in poor health with a heavy protozoa infestation. The narrator, concerned about the turtle's well-being, examines the protozoa under a microscope and determines a course of treatment with Panacur, expressing hope for the turtle's recovery.
